query:
DELETE FROM users u
             WHERE u.is_guest
               AND u.created_at < now() - interval '1 day'
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_id = u.id)
               AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM games g
                               WHERE g.white_user_id = u.id OR g.black_user_id = u.id)
